title: Talent Acquisition Sourcer
description:
DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

As a Talent Acquisition Sourcer at DiDi, you will join a dynamic, cross-functional team focused on scaling our Middle Platform across LATAM. You'll own sourcing strategies and help build high-performing teams by connecting top talent with exciting opportunities.

You’ll thrive in our fast-paced, high-growth environment — ready to roll up your sleeves, think strategically, and deliver results under tight deadlines.

In this role, you'll be...

  1. Own and lead sourcing strategies and performance for hiring managers across LATAM.
  2. Partner closely with Recruiters and TC teams to meet monthly hiring goals.
  3. Develop talent maps and market insights to support strategic org design decisions.
  4. Build and maintain strong relationships with top talent pools for current and future opportunities.
  5. Stay current on market trends, key players, and competitor intelligence.
  6. Train and advise hiring managers on sourcing best practices and interviewing.
  7. Support hiring across global functions such as Legal, HR, Finance, Marketing, and PR when needed.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  1. Bachelor's or Master’s degree in HR, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  2. Minimum 2 years of sourcing experience in a high-volume recruiting environment (in-house or agency).
  3. Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  4. Proficiency in sourcing tools and platforms (LinkedIn, LinkedIn Insights, Boolean Search, OCC, etc.).
  5. Strong project management and organizational skills — ability to manage multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously.
  6. Fluent in English. Spanish and Portuguese are highly desirable.
  7. Self-starter, independent, and comfortable working with minimal supervision.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

  1. We create user value: We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.
  2. We are data-driven: We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  3. Win-win Collaboration: Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  4. We believe in integrity: Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  5. Growth: We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  6. Diversity and Inclusion: Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us. We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Are you an engineer with a passion for data center design and looking for a challenge to chart your own course? If so, we are looking for you to help us make history.
AWS data centers are the foundation upon which our software and services operates to meet the growing demands of our customers. This role provides the opportunity to collaborate with business development, design engineers, data center operations professionals, external vendors and consultants, and other cross-functional teams to assess and select colocation facilities that meet our business requirements.
You will be able to showcase your in-depth understanding of data center design, engineering, and operations of infrastructure common to data centers, telecommunications facilities and other critical environment infrastructure.
You will work directly with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability.
You will have opportunities to influence standards for data center products, build and improve processes, and to guide the direction of our colocation data center portfolio on a global scale. So, if you are a strong leader with solid data center mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural (MEPS) infrastructure design engineering experience, Amazon will present a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment that is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional rewarding opportunity for you.
You Will Be Responsible For The Following
Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers, legacy facility upgrades, and general capital endeavors.
Perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit-for-use/fit-for-service.
Influence AWS’ design and specification requirements to meet our business needs for AWS colocation products.
Investigate and document root-cause failure analysis associated with infrastructure and equipment failures.
Work with vendors and local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and codes.
Collaborate with engineering, construction, operations, and commissioning teams to properly test and validate the installation, operation, and performance of critical electrical/mechanical/fire suppression/controls systems/structural systems.
Support Operations, data scientists and other business partners to determine utilization, efficiency, and performance analysis on critical systems.
Travel to Data Center sites as required - International & Domestic (up to 50%)
Key job responsibilities
Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers and telecommunications facilities within the region.
Reviews vendor critical infrastructure designs and perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit-for-use/fit-for-service for AWS cloud compute and networking services.
Supports AWS Construction and Commissioning works as Resident Engineer and then partner up with Operations teams as on-site/field engineer during data center operational lifecycle.
About The Team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications

  • Engineering degree in Mechanical or related discipline.
  • Cumulative 10+ years of focused experience in Data Center or Carrier-class Telecommunications design, Power Generation, Oil & Gas, Aviation engineering, and/or operations and maintenance (O&M) of data center/critical environment infrastructure.

  • PhD or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related area.

Mais do que contratar pessoas, queremos gerar oportunidades para todos, garantindo a inclusão de perfis cada vez mais diversos para somar com NOSSA GENTE! Se você também pensa assim, que tal fazer parte desse time?
Responsabilidades:
1. Apoio nas Tarefas de Funilaria
Auxiliar na Fabricação de Peças: O auxiliar de funilaria ajuda na execução de atividades como corte, dobragem, soldagem e montagem de peças metálicas, sob a supervisão de um funileiro. Ele prepara os materiais e organiza as ferramentas necessárias para o processo.
Preparação e Organizações de Ferramentas: Organizar e garantir que as ferramentas de funilaria estejam em boas condições de uso, prontas para serem utilizadas pelos profissionais da área. Isso pode envolver a limpeza, calibração e manutenção preventiva das ferramentas.
2. Organização do Ambiente de Trabalho
Manter a Limpeza e a Organização: Um auxiliar de funilaria é responsável por manter o local de trabalho limpo e organizado, o que ajuda a aumentar a produtividade e a reduzir acidentes. Isso inclui a organização de materiais, ferramentas e o descarte correto de resíduos de metal ou outros materiais.
3. Segurança no Trabalho
Cumprir as Normas de Segurança: O auxiliar de funilaria deve seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança, utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados, como luvas, óculos, protetores auriculares, aventais e máscaras. Ele também deve garantir que os colegas de trabalho também sigam essas normas.
4. Apoio no Processo de Soldagem
Auxiliar na Preparação de Peças para Soldagem: Preparar e posicionar as peças para soldagem, garantindo que elas estejam devidamente alinhadas e limpas, sem impurezas ou oxidação que possam comprometer a qualidade do trabalho.

Trabalho com Ferramentas Manuais: O auxiliar de funilaria deve ter habilidade manual para operar ferramentas como martelos, chaves, limas e alicates, além de ser capaz de usar dispositivos mais complexos, como prensas e cortadores de metal.

Compreensão dos Materiais Metálicos: O auxiliar de funilaria deve ter conhecimento sobre os tipos de metais (ferro, aço, alumínio, cobre, etc.) e suas propriedades, como resistência e maleabilidade. Isso ajuda na escolha do material certo para cada tarefa

  • Atenção concentrada, agilidade, proatividade, organização do trabalho e Trabalho em equipe.

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF.

Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil.

Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência.

Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas.

Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor.

Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito.

  2. Curso técnico em vendas, comercial ou áreas de beleza (cosmetologia, maquiagem, cabeleireiro, manicure);

Flexibilidade e rotina:

Fundada em 1986, promove ações de bem-estar, desenvolvimento social e cultural, oferecendo serviços exclusivos, clube de descontos e vantagens em diversas áreas.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Mãe denuncia injúria racial sofrida por filha no Senai, em Divinópolis
description:
• Mãe denuncia injúria racial sofrida por filha no Senai, emDivinópolis

Mãe denuncia injúria racial sofridapor filha no Senai, em Divinópolis

Uma mulher gravou um vídeo nesta quinta-feira (27) por meio doqual denuncia uma situação de injúria racial sofrida pela filha, noSenai, que fica no bairro Esplanada, em Divinópolis. Conforme asexplicações dela, um colega de classe da filha seria o responsávelpelo crime.

Durante o vídeo, a mãe conta que foi até a escola parasolucionar o problema, na manhã de hoje (27), e que a luta éconstante e que não permitirá que tal situação aconteça com afilha. A mãe reforça também a necessidade de autovalorização erespeito. O SENAI se posicionou sobre o caso, informando que nãoteve envolvimento de nenhum funcionário da escola, e que lamenta oocorrido com a estudante. A escola informou ainda que o causador dainjúria racial, sendo outro estudante da instituição, passará pormedidas reeducativas. Veja abaixo o posicionamento completodo SENAI e também o vídeo feito pela mãe.

“O SENAI Anielo Greco, localizado em Divinópolis, lamentaprofundamente o episódio de injúria racial ocorrido nasdependências da unidade e esclarece que as ofensas racistas foramproferidas por um aluno menor de idade, direcionadas a uma colega,não havendo envolvimento de nenhum colaborador daentidade.

É importante ressaltar que, desde o momento em que foiinformada sobre o ocorrido, o SENAI escutou, acolheu e garantiu àvítima e sua mãe a devida apuração dos fatos e a tomada dasprovidências cabíveis. Para tanto, foi necessário um tempo mínimopara a realização de diligências e a análise das metodologiaspedagógicas já previstas pela entidade, o que foi acordado entre aspartes.

Com o intuito de manter seu compromisso de trabalhar pelaformação integral do indivíduo, a definição da medida disciplinarpertinente ao caso deve levar em consideração o contexto social efamiliar do aluno. Dessa forma, o SENAI age no sentido de educar osjovens para além da competência técnica, acreditando no processo deformação cidadã e preparando o indivíduo para viver em sociedadecom respeito e dignidade.

Diante do exposto, o SENAI reitera que as medidasdisciplinares pertinentes estão sendo definidas com o objetivo deeducar e recuperar o indivíduo. A entidade reafirma seu repúdio aqualquer tipo de preconceito e se coloca como parceira da sociedadeno processo de transformação cidadã”.

description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth story while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

VENHA E CRESÇA JUNTO COM A GENTE!

Estamos em busca de Operador de Cedoc!

Coloque suas habilidades e conhecimentos em prática e faça a diferença! Se gosta de movimento, trabalho em altura (superior a 2 metros) e organização, essa oportunidade é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Respeitar as normas e procedimentos de segurança e uso de EPI’s (Equipamento de Proteção Individual) fornecidos pela empresa e higiene do trabalho estabelecidas para a sua área de atuação;
  2. Implantar e incluir volumes (caixas) no sistema interno SKP (SafeKeeper), receber e conferir a demanda, efetuar a troca da cartonagem quando necessário e liberar volume para a guarda, mantendo assim a organização e garantia dos processos;
  3. Movimentar caixas manualmente ou com auxílio de equipamentos manuais ou de força motriz própria, dentro das dependências da Unidade;
  4. Localizar, quais os locais (endereços) em que as caixas serão guardadas conforme sistema interno SKP, e levá-las a este local, utilizando-se de diversos recursos, como: leitor de código de barras, carrinhos, escadas, prateleiras equipadas com rodízios, etc;
  5. Procurar e localizar caixas de documentos, seguindo instruções ou indicações de endereços (corredores, prateleiras, níveis, etc) estabelecidos pelos procedimentos vigentes ou instruções dadas pelo superior. Após os trabalhos de pesquisa, retornar estes volumes ao local inicial;
  6. Preencher relatórios de suas atividades diárias (formulário OPLOG), conforme os modelos e procedimentos IMB, para avaliação e controle da produção individual e do departamento;
  7. Zelar para que todos os volumes e equipamentos usados sejam preservados nas condições de conservação;
  8. Relatar qualquer alteração ou irregularidade nos equipamentos de movimentação de carga, auxiliando no preenchimento da lista de verificação (check-list);
  9. Quando não há trabalhos de sua função direta poderá auxiliar os demais departamentos.

REQUISITOS

  1. Ensino Médio completo
  2. Atenção concentrada, agilidade, proatividade, organização do trabalho e Trabalho em equipe.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de máxima qualidade para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local, ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos em um ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes, permitindo desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Gurilândia e a Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação. Essas escolas se baseiam em quatro pilares: Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos, educamos gerações em Salvador, preparando nossos alunos para os desafios atuais com uma educação que une vanguarda e tradição.

Acreditamos que o acesso a serviços financeiros deve ser transparente, seguro e alinhado às necessidades reais de quem confia em nós.

Nosso crescimento é sustentado por uma cultura corporativa forte, pautada em princípios fundamentais:

Compromisso com o cliente – O cliente está no centro de tudo o que fazemos. Nosso propósito é atender com excelência, garantindo experiências positivas e soluções eficazes.
Meritocracia – Valorizamos e reconhecemos aqueles que geram resultados sustentáveis e concretos, incentivando um ambiente de alta performance.
Confidencialidade – Trabalhamos com sigilo absoluto , garantindo a segurança e a privacidade das informações.
Colaboração e respeito – Acreditamos que um ambiente produtivo nasce do respeito mútuo e do trabalho em equipe.
Transparência – Nossos processos são conduzidos com clareza, ética e compromisso com a verdade.
Responsabilidade – Fazer o que precisa ser feito, com compromisso e excelência.
Evolução contínua – Estamos sempre em busca de aprendizado e inovação para aprimorar nossos serviços e processos.

Nosso Futuro

Nossa visão é consolidar uma operação própria, transformando lojas em agências financeiras estratégicas , fortalecendo a proximidade com nossos clientes e ampliando nossa presença no mercado.

Se você busca fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a inovação, a meritocracia e o crescimento sustentável, a Vale Mais Promotora é o lugar certo para sua carreira!

Sobre a Vaga

O(a) Assistente de Soluções Financeiras será responsável pelo atendimento de clientes, apresentando as melhores opções de crédito e produtos financeiros. Este profissional desempenha um papel fundamental na experiência do cliente, garantindo um atendimento eficiente, seguro e consultivo, com foco na conversão de vendas e no atingimento das metas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

Realizar atendimento ativo e receptivo (telefone, presencial e digital).
Identificar a modalidade de crédito mais adequada para cada cliente.
Apresentar e vender produtos financeiros de forma consultiva.
Esclarecer dúvidas sobre taxas, contratos e condições.
Coletar, validar e conferir documentação para análise de crédito.
Inserir e acompanhar propostas no sistema YUPPIE.
Monitorar o andamento das operações e solucionar pendências.
Auxiliar na formalização de contratos e assinaturas digitais.
Manter comunicação ativa com clientes, garantindo um excelente pós-venda.
Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe comercial para conversão de leads.
Cumprir metas de vendas e produtividade diariamente.
Seguir normas regulatórias, incluindo a LGPD.
Sugerir melhorias e inovações nos processos comerciais.

Requisitos Necessários

● Ensino Médio completo, Técnico ou Superior (cursando ou concluído).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

● Vivência em ambientes de alta performance e metas.

Benefícios e Remuneração

Explicar os exercícios em detalhes e sugerir alternativas, se necessário;
Monitorar o progresso dos níveis de condicionamento físico;
Realizar RCP e administrar os primeiros socorros em caso de emergência;
Informar sobre as diretrizes de segurança e higiene da academia; Desenvolver um relacionamento positivo e de confiança com os clientes;
Explicar como usar corretamente e com segurança os equipamentos da academia; Manter a organização dos pesos e equipamentos, segundo disposição estabelecida pela Contratante.

Somos uma equipe dedicada a cuidar de pessoas, valorizando características, histórias e qualidades únicas de cada indivíduo. Nosso propósito é viver plenamente, com orgulho de nossa história e foco no futuro.

Valorizamos a valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação e soluções em tudo que fazemos. Se você compartilha desses valores, venha fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente onde todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional, com pessoas engajadas em alcançar resultados e oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Realizar rotinas de limpeza operacional (predial, equipamentos de movimentação, etc.) conforme procedimentos, operando equipamentos de manutenção capacitado.
  2. Zelar pela limpeza, organização, conservação de ferramentas e equipamentos, atendendo às normas e procedimentos.
  3. Participar de atividades de levantamento de inventário de produtos e controle de estoque (contagens cíclicas).
  4. Realizar triagem e reformas nos paletes utilizados na operação, bem como triagem e retrabalho de produtos avariados.
  5. Zelar pelos equipamentos, recursos, materiais sob sua responsabilidade e ambiente de trabalho, cumprindo normas de segurança.
  6. Cumprir regulamentos internos, requisitos de sistemas de gestão da qualidade, preservação ambiental, saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho, incluindo o uso de EPIs/EPCs.
  7. Desenvolver outras atividades relacionadas ao cargo ou a critério do superior, de acordo com sua experiência.
  8. Ensino médio completo.

Disponibilidade de atuação: Tarde, das 13:00 às 21:20, e sábado, das 11:00 às 19:20.

Requisitos adicionais:

  • Experiência em coleta de dados.
  • Experiência em logística.

Benefícios:

  • Refeitório no local.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Educação corporativa Upfarma.
  • Convênio médico.
  • Crédito consignado.
  • Programa Educa Mais.
  • Cesta por produtividade e metas.
  • Gympass/wellhub.

Valorizamos a diversidade e não fazemos distinções de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são nossa origem e propósito. Promover acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente, presente em todos os estados do país, sendo gigantes e diversos por natureza.

Nascemos em 1981, em Fortaleza-CE, e, através de valores como valorização humana, superação de resultados, foco no cliente, sustentabilidade, integridade e inovação, tornamo-nos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios baseia-se na venda de produtos e serviços de saúde e bem-estar, atuando no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Desde 2016, implementamos o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico com atendimento individualizado em salas equipadas.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil pessoas unidas por um propósito: garantir acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil, para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente. Se você gosta de servir e cuidar de pessoas, venha ser Gigante conosco!

Muito prazer, somos a Naturativa!

Hoje, estamos presentes em mais de 160 países! Somos parceiros das melhores e maiores locadoras, em mais de 5 mil cidades e 20 mil pontos de retirada em todo o mundo.

Com sedes em Curitiba (PR) e em Amsterdã (na Holanda), somos globais e focados em excelência e inovação!   • Opção por vale-transporte, com desconto de 3%.

Amplie suas possibilidades com:

  • Meu Pet Club, plano de saúde pet;
  • Plano odontológico (Metlife), podendo incluir dependentes;
  • Wellhub para se exercitar e movimentar o corpo;

  • InvestPass para auxiliar na organização financeira;

Outros benefícios, válidos para todos os Renties:

POSITION: Hazardous Waste Technician

SEASON: Winfly (Aug 2026 - Oct 2026)

LOCATION : McMurdo Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT : Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Responsible for the collection, processing and packaging of all hazardous waste on station, including legal classification, required packaging and proper labeling of all containers.
  2. Ability to be extremely detail oriented and meet a high level of quality control regarding highly regulated USAP hazardous wastes.
  3. Ability to learn and follow all ACA, EPA, NRC, IMDG, DOT, State, rules and regulations regarding hazardous wastes being shipped.
  4. Ability to complete all documentation and tracking to a high degree of accuracy.
  5. Serves as a station Spill Team Member and is on call for one week out of every four, twenty-four hours a day.
  6. Pick up hazardous waste and associated paperwork from various departments on station, assuring quality of information on Hazardous Waste Identification Sheet (HWIS).
  7. Perform certain classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  8. Perform labpacking duties if applicable.
  9. Perform safe operation of an articulating forklift (Case M4K).
  10. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  11. Assist the Solid Waste Department as needed.
  12. Ability to supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  13. Write spill reports, if applicable.
  14. Regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools and other tools.
  15. Position requires constant physical activity, including bending, consistently lifting and carrying 50 - 70 lbs, reaching and gripping.
  16. Perform ancillary support to station Spill Team, including on-call duties after hours and possible night shift duties.
  17. Agrees with and adheres to the Standard Operating Procedures and tasking responsibilities of the Waste department.
  18. Able to work in a team unit composed of diverse personalities.
  19. Displays self-motivation in physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is comprised of approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  20. Able to maintain flexibility and positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  21. Performs duties in support of Operations Division metrics (as provided by supervisor).
  22. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position's work activities.
  23. Complies with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety, and Quality Assurance, requirements and goals. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  24. Works to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  25. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  26. Perform other duties as required.
  27. Reports to Hazardous Waste Supervisor.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  2. Strong computer software experience.
  3. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  4. Valid Driver's License and Passport.
  5. Physically able to be active for 9 hours daily.
  6. Must be able to lift the safety regulation maximum and perform functions requiring repetitive motion required.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.
  9. A prerequisite of employment for this position is to successfully gain a favorable Tier 1 - Elevated Background Investigation (EBI) result prior to deployment. Candidates hired for this position will be required to complete; online forms, written forms, fingerprint cards and provide additional details and information as requested by NSF Personnel Security.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  3. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  4. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  5. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour, current.
  6. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  7. Equipment operating experience.

EDUCATION: College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS: Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER: US citizenship or permanent residency required.

  1. Obedecer normas técnicas

  4. Inspecionar sensitivamente máquinas e equipamentos

  10. Monitorar equipamentos eletroeletrônicos
  11. Ajustar componentes e dispositivos elétricos
  12. Lubrificar componentes eletroeletrônicos
  13. Testar o funcionamento dos componentes e equipamentos

INSTALAR SISTEMAS E COMPONENTES ELETROELETRÔNICOS

  7. Liberar máquinas, equipamentos e sistemas para testes de funcionamento

REALIZAR MEDIÇÕES E TESTES

  1. Verificar tensões dos sistemas
  2. Verificar resistências dos componentes eletroeletrônicos
  3. Medir correntes dos circuitos

REALIZAR SERVIÇOS SEGUNDO NORMAS DE SEGURANÇA, MEIO AMBIENTE E SAÚDE OCUPACIONAL

description:
POSITION: Hazardous Waste Technician

SEASON: Winter 2026

LOCATION : McMurdo Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT : Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Responsible for the collection, processing, and packaging of all hazardous waste on station, including legal classification, required packaging, and proper labeling of all containers.
  2. Ability to be extremely detail-oriented and meet a high level of quality control regarding highly regulated USAP hazardous wastes.
  3. Ability to learn and follow all ACA, EPA, NRC, IMDG, DOT, State rules, and regulations regarding hazardous wastes being shipped.
  4. Ability to complete all documentation and tracking to a high degree of accuracy.
  5. Serves as a station Spill Team Member and is on call for one week out of every four, twenty-four hours a day.
  6. Pick up hazardous waste and associated paperwork from various departments on station, assuring quality of information on Hazardous Waste Identification Sheet (HWIS).
  7. Perform certain classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  8. Perform lab packing duties if applicable.
  9. Perform safe operation of an articulating forklift (Case M4K).
  10. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  11. Assist the Solid Waste Department as needed.
  12. Ability to supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  13. Write spill reports, if applicable.
  14. Regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools, and other tools.
  15. Position requires constant physical activity, including bending, consistently lifting and carrying 50 - 70 lbs, reaching, and gripping.
  16. Perform ancillary support to station Spill Team, including on-call duties after hours and possible night shift duties.
  17. Agrees with and adheres to the Standard Operating Procedures and tasking responsibilities of the Waste department.
  18. Able to work in a team unit composed of diverse personalities.
  19. Displays self-motivation in physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is comprised of approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  20. Able to maintain flexibility and positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  21. Performs duties in support of Operations Division metrics (as provided by supervisor).
  22. Supports the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position's work activities.
  23. Complies with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety, and Quality Assurance, requirements and goals. Provides documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  24. Works to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  25. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  26. Perform other duties as required.
  27. Reports to Waste Management Specialist.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  2. Strong computer software experience.
  3. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  4. Valid Driver's License and Passport.
  5. Able to stand for up to 12 hours daily.
  6. Must be able to lift the safety regulation maximum and perform functions requiring repetitive motion required.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  3. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  4. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  5. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour, current.
  6. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  7. Equipment operating experience.

EDUCATION: College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS: Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER: US citizenship or permanent residency required.

title: Recruiting Assistant
description:
Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises — including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass — use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

The Recruiting team is the growth engine, enabling our teams to hire world-class talent at incredible speed. We partner with leaders across the company to act as talent advisors while keeping candidate experience, diversity, and operational efficiency at the core of all processes. We are collaborative and supportive, always focusing on the success of the team, and help candidates dream big for both their careers and the future of Brex.

What you’ll do

You will join our team of Candidate Experience Coordinators who own, manage, and elevate candidate experience at Brex. You are passionate about offering support to your internal stakeholders - which includes recruiters, sourcers, interviewers, and hiring managers - and will serve as the main point of contact for candidates, all while keeping quality top of mind. The ideal candidate is eager to learn and interested in gaining exposure to all aspects of the recruiting process – from sourcing to full-cycle recruiting, operations, and candidate experience.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Sao Paulo office. You must be willing to work in office at least 2 days per week on Wednesday and Thursday, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when we open our Sao Paulo office. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year.

Responsibilities

  • Schedule, coordinate, and manage interviews across multiple time zones in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Serve as the point of contact for candidates throughout their interview process, ensuring a positive experience from start to finish
  • Prioritize daily tasks while maintaining responsiveness with candidates, recruiters, interviewers, and team members
  • Proactively identify process gaps and spearhead projects to improve the coordination function
  • Build trust with your internal stakeholders through effective communication and problem-solving

Requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize accordingly
  • Keen attention to detail and highly developed organizational skills
  • Comfortable learning new technologies (ex: Greenhouse, CodeSignal, ModernLoop)
  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

*Applications, including resumes, must be submitted in English in order to be considered for the role

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with abrex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

What is this role?

The Strategic Finance Manager will play a critical role in driving the company’s financial strategy and supporting key business decisions through comprehensive analysis. You will be instrumental in shaping our pricing governance, developing innovative pricing strategies, and assessing market competitiveness. This position requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical skills who can translate financial data into actionable insights. Additionally, you will lead and manage strategic projects that directly contribute to our company’s growth and profitability objectives. Collaboration with senior leadership and cross-functional teams will be essential to ensure alignment and drive impactful initiatives.

This position is based in a hybrid capacity inBelo Horizonte or São Paulo, 1-2 days per week in the office.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build, oversee and govern pricing structures to ensure alignment with company objectives and market standards.
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge pricing strategies while conducting thorough competitiveness assessments to optimize our market positioning.
  • Lead and manage special projects focused on strategic initiatives, leveraging data-driven insights to inform decision-making and enhance business performance.

What You'll Bring:

  • Consulting Experience: Previous experience in a consulting firm, preferably in a role focused on GTM strategies, pricing strategy, business analysis, or financial consulting, which can bring diverse perspectives and methodologies to the team.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and manage large sets of data and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Experience with quantitative analysis and familiarity with pricing models.
  • A curious mindset , with a continuous desire to uncover underlying trends and insights.
  • Exceptional team player , eager to foster collaboration and support cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on approach to problem-solving, demonstrating willingness to dive into the details in finding solutions and demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness to achieve results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills: Capable of articulating complex analyses clearly and effectively to various stakeholders.
  • Presentation Skills: Experience in creating and delivering impactful presentations to senior leadership and stakeholders, highlighting analytical findings and recommendations clearly.

Nice to Have:

  • Advanced Analytical Tools: Proficiency in advanced analytical tools and software (e.g., Tableau, SQL, R, Python) for more sophisticated data analysis and visualization.
  • Networking Abilities: Existing professional network within the industry that could provide valuable insights and foster partnerships.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering on complex projects within tight deadlines, showcasing effective project management capabilities.
  • Business Acumen : Strong business acumen with the ability to connect pricing strategies to broader business objectives and financial performance.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the industry in which the company operates, enabling a better understanding of market dynamics and competitive pressures.
  • Change Management Exposure : Knowledge or experience in change management processes, especially in implementing new pricing strategies or business models.

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. title: Prefeitura amplia prazo de seleção de 500 cuidadores escolares até este sábado
description:
Prefeitura amplia prazo de seleção de 500 cuidadores escolares até este sábado

21 de Maio de 2025 | 15h 35

A Secretaria Municipal de Educação de Feira de Santana informa que o edital do Processo Seletivo Simplificado para contratação temporária de Cuidadores foi republicado por incorreção nesta quarta-feira (21), com ajustes importantes no cronograma e nos critérios de avaliação curricular. A medida visa garantir maior clareza e equidade ao certame, que oferta 500 vagas para atuação junto a estudantes com necessidades educacionais específicas da Educação Municipal.

Uma das principais mudanças é a ampliação do prazo de inscrições, que agora vai até 23h59 deste sábado (24 de maio). Antes, os candidatos tinham até o dia 23 de maio para se inscrever. As inscrições continuam sendo realizadas de forma gratuita, exclusivamente por meio do link: ( ).

Critérios de pontuação foram reformulados

Outra alteração significativa está no barema de avaliação dos currículos. O novo edital amplia a pontuação máxima de 30 para 100 pontos, incluindo novos critérios como a formação de nível médio, que passa a valer 70 pontos, e reformula a distribuição dos demais itens, como cursos de formação, eventos e experiência profissional. O objetivo é tornar o processo mais objetivo e condizente com o perfil exigido para a função.

Cronograma foi antecipado

Além das mudanças nos critérios de seleção, o cronograma de etapas também sofreu alterações. As fases de análise curricular, publicação de resultados, prazos de recurso e homologação final foram antecipadas em cerca de 10 dias. Agora, a análise dos currículos ocorrerá entre 26 de maio e 4 de junho, e o resultado final será homologado em 16 de junho deste ano.

Executive and Admin Support Associate (Sao Paulo)

About Eurasia Group

Eurasia Group is the world's leading global political risk research and consulting firm. By providing information and insight on how political developments move markets, we help clients anticipate and respond to instability and opportunities everywhere they invest or do business. Our expertise includes developed and developing countries in every region of the world, specific economic sectors, and the business and investment playing fields of the future. With our best-in-class advisory and consulting offerings and GZERO Media, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides the marketplace with a complete political risk solution. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, San Francisco, Brasilia, Sao Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo, as well as on-the-ground experts and resources in more than a hundred countries. "Politics first” grounds our work: Politics is the lens through which we view the world, and we are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.

Job Description: Executive and Admin Support Associate

We are seeking an administrative professional with a minimum of 3 years of relevant office experience within a fast-paced client-services organization. This is an in-office full-time position. Qualified applicants will also have a strong sense of professionalism, punctuality, diplomacy, and confidentiality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills (both in English and Brazilian Portuguese; Spanish a plus); the ability to handle multiple responsibilities and priorities; strong sense of attention to detail; exceptional interpersonal skills and must be proactive rather than reactive .

Preferred candidates must have strong Microsoft Suite experience, experience with business travel booking and expense reconciliation, calendar management, and experience working in a professional services environment. Experience with Salesforce and Concur is a plus but will train as necessary. Executive and Admin Support Associate will report to the Associate Director, Brazil Business Operations.

All applicants must be eligible to work in Brazil – São Paulo. Please submit all resumes in English.

The Food & Beverage Cost Controller

plays a pivotal role in the HORECA industry, with a primary responsibility for ensuring cost-efficiency and profitability within the food and beverage operations of our establishment. This position, part of the finance team, is dedicated to controlling costs, optimizing inventory management, and contributing to the financial success of our food and beverage services.

Cost Control and Analysis:

  • Monitor and analyze food and beverage costs, identifying trends and discrepancies.
  • Implement cost control measures to optimize expenses while maintaining quality.

  • Assist in the development of annual budgets for food and beverage operations.

Supplier Relations:

  • Maintain strong relationships with food and beverage suppliers.
  • Evaluate supplier performance and negotiate contracts for cost-effective procurement.
  • Monitor the quality and consistency of incoming products.

Reporting and Documentation:

  • Prepare and maintain accurate records of food and beverage costs and inventory.
  • Generate regular reports on cost control and inventory management for management review.
  • Communicate cost-saving opportunities and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Undertake weekly Food Flash Reports at outlets as requested by the CFO or COO.
  • Coordinate weekly inventory checks, providing detailed reports to the CFO/COO, along with action plans to address discrepancies.

  • Investigate any cost-related issues and provide action plans to rectify identified problems.

Requirements Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Professional Qualified Certification of ICWA, CMA.
  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in food and beverage cost control within the HORECA industry.

Job Specific Skills:

  • Cost control and analysis expertise.

  • Financial reporting and analysis.
  • Attention to detail and analytical abilities.

Competencies:

  • Cost-conscious mindset.

  • Communication and teamwork.
  • Adaptability and flexibility.
  • Knowledge of HORECA industry standards and practices.

• Guiding prospects through the sales cycle to contract and close, collaborating with presales and specialist teams as needed.

• Supporting customers through onboarding and implementation phases, in partnership with the Field Account Manager, ensuring a seamless transition and ongoing revenue life cycle management.

• Able to demonstrate experience in business development and account management.

• Have excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

• Able to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Display analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Este banco de talentos é destinado a candidatos que desejam fazer parte do nosso time, mas ainda não encontraram uma vaga ideal. Esperamos poder direcioná-lo para alguma oportunidade em breve.

Como funciona o nosso fluxo:

  1. Quando surgir uma vaga na sua cidade, buscaremos em nosso Banco de Talentos por candidatos compatíveis com o perfil desejado.
  2. Se você atender aos requisitos, entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para convidá-lo a participar do processo seletivo.
  3. Fique atento às notificações e ao seu e-mail.

Seguimos as determinações da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Portanto, só poderemos movimentar seu cadastro entre as vagas se você autorizar, no seu cadastro, o armazenamento do seu currículo por tempo indeterminado.

História do Grupo Mult

A trajetória do Grupo Mult começou com Maxwell Lage, que em julho de 1993 abriu uma revenda de automóveis multimarcas em Governador Valadares (MG). Com o tempo, a empresa se consolidou como uma das maiores na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.

Para conhecer melhor essa evolução, confira a linha do tempo a seguir:

  1. 1993: Fundação em Governador Valadares (MG). Rápido crescimento, com filiais em Caratinga, Ipatinga e Teófilo Otoni.
  2. 2004: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Mitsubishi Motors e expandiu suas operações para outras cidades de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo.
  3. 2012: Inauguração da Kobe Nissan, tornando-se referência nacional e recebendo a honraria Revenda Samurai.
  4. 2020: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Renault em Governador Valadares.
  5. 2021: Inauguração da Multicar Mega Store em Vitória (ES) e conquista da concessão da Royal Enfield.
  6. Hoje: Com 16 lojas, incluindo unidades Nissan, Mitsubishi, Renault, Royal Enfield e uma loja de carros esportivos, além de atuar nos setores imobiliário, de seguros e veículos por assinatura.

Overview

At Powerback, we're on a mission to improve lives. As the leader in physical, occupational, speech, and respiratory therapies, we help older adults stay active and thrive while providing essential therapy for children at home and in school.


With over 38 years of trusted service, our reach spans skilled nursing centers, assisted and independent living facilities, outpatient clinics, and home-based care. We're proud to deliver personalized care exactly where and when it's needed most.


Join an industry-leading team that restores hope and makes a lasting impact. If you're passionate about making a meaningful difference and want to be part of the future of rehabilitation and wellness, Powerback is the place for you.


Why Powerback?

  • Benefits: We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to Full-Time and Part-Time team members.
  • Support for New Grads & Clinical Fellows: Our Powerback Clinical Mentorship Program kicks off on day one, helping you learn from the best in the field.
  • Continuing Education: Keep growing with free CEUs through Medbridge.
  • H-1B Visa & Relocation Assistance: We support Visa or Green Card sponsorships, plus our Journey Travel Program lets you work across the U.S. with the security of a full-time role.
  • Perks at Powerback: Enjoy exclusive discounts on Wireless/TV, Home/Auto/Renters and Pet Insurance, Childcare, Eldercare, and more. Earn rewards through our PowerZone Employee Recognition Program, and expand your expertise with our Clinicians in Action professional development program.


Responsibilities

Title: Occupational Therapy Assistant
Location/work environment: In facility
Reporting structure: Reporting to Director of Rehab


As an Occupational Therapy Assistant, you help patients get well. You are the person who can bring their power back. In doing this, you will implement occupational therapy programs and activities, follow developed recovery plans, and deliver therapy treatments.

You're a healer and a helper, which is why you got into this line of work.

You're equally adept at addressing the whole patient and seeing them as an individual. You know your goal is to execute a program that will restore, reinforce, and enhance their physical abilities and independence.

You're adaptable to the needs of the patient and can find joy in the variety of the work and the settings.

You're a teammate and are looking for collaboration with your peers, but you're also happy to make referrals to help your patient get the care they need to thrive.

You know that being an Occupational Therapy Assistant means putting patients first; ensuring patients and their families receive the highest quality of service in a caring and compassionate atmosphere.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you!


Powerback Rehabilitation (Powerback) is a new way of delivering recovery, rehabilitation, respiratory, and wellness services to patients across the nation. We deliver an empowered approach to achieving your full potential by providing integrated and individualized solutions. Our reimagined approach to rehabilitation connects directly to the patient experience, which is centered on transforming the road to recovery for everyone and helping patients get their power back. It's patient-centered care that provides a sustainable way of feeling better, moving better, breathing better, and living better.


Working in a company that values growth and understands what it means to be a caregiver is refreshing. Our CEO is a former staff therapist. We offer growth, paths forward, and we are committed to patient-centered care. We are growing, stable, and need people like you, who have a calling to help people thrive.

Isn't it time for you to work with a team where 86% of them know and feel their work makes a difference? So much so, we're certified as a 2023 Great Place to Work.

Now is the time for you to join Powerback.


Powerback has streamlined our hiring process:

1. Applying takes 3 minutes, give or take.
2. You'll hear back from us within 1 business day.
3. If you meet the qualifications, a recruiter will call you for a 10-minute conversation within 2-3 business days, depending on your availability.
4. You will then be presented to the hiring manager.
5. The hiring manager will reach out within a business day to schedule the interview.


This all happens within 1-5 business days from the phone screen.

6. After your interview, the hiring manager makes a quick decision. We aim to accomplish this within the week.
7. If the hiring manager wants to move forward, you will hear from us within a business day, because we are excited to get you started!


Qualifications

1. Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant Program according to AOTA & ACOTE standards.
2. Initial certification obtained from the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy.
3. They must be licensed and/or eligible for licensure as required in the state of practice.


Posted Salary Range

USD $28.00 - USD $38.00 /Hr.

Amazon.com.br is looking for a smart and driven Instock Manager to join our Mass Vendor Relations team in Brazil. This person will have responsibility for ensuring inventory systems and processes are meeting the needs of the business and implementing controls around these. The right candidate thrives in a high energy environment where tactical and strategic activities are expected to be driven in parallel.


The Instock Manager will own driving improvement in inventory availability, increasing inventory efficiency, selection growth and improving purchasing processes. The successful candidate possesses a track record of successful implementation and execution of inventory management practices, leveraging strong analytical acumen and working with cross-functional teams. The position requires an individual who can work autonomously in a highly demanding and often ambiguous environment, with strong attention to detail. The candidate should be able to manage multiple vendors simultaneously and make sure items are always available to our customers in Brazil. This role is located in São Paulo, Brazil.


At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we engage in and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of 'Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer.' Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that 'Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility.' Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon 'It’s always Day 1.' Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.


Key job responsibilities

Inventory & Supply Chain Management:

  1. Manage the supply chain to guarantee an efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows among: forecasting, purchasing, and solving receipts problems
  2. Work with vendors to ensure a reliable and operationally effective flow of goods
  3. Deliver maximum available selection in the category
  4. Design seasonal and promotional inventory preparation plan
  5. Control budgets and deliver actions to meet inventory targets
  6. Execute action plans to reduce return/liquidation costs

Operational Efficiency:

  1. Measure and improve purchasing lead times, reduce operational defects, and improve systems to streamline operations between vendors and Amazon
  2. Perform root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and manage improvements

Project Management:

  1. Work with internal teams to drive system, tools and process improvements/implementation that affect purchasing and vendor management workflow, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually
  2. Develop analysis of key business metrics, with emphasis on developing and executing recommendations for improvement
  3. Lead projects from initial development to implementation that will streamline supply systems and processes and drive operational improvements.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Advanced English Proficiency
- Experience in product/category management or commercial planning.
- Experience in logistics, supply chain and/or supply management

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of the principles of statistical inventory control
- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
- Proficiency in SQL and database concepts

title: LAV NORTE - OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA | IRANDUBA/AM
description:
Seja muito bem vindos ao Grupo Bringel, inovação e ousadia estão no nosso DNA.

A Lav norte é uma lavanderia industrial especializada em soluções integradas em higienização de enxovais hospitalares, hotelaria e industriais, oferecendo um serviço de alta qualidade e excelência, com foco na segurança e bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Temos experiência no mercado, com um parque equipado com alta tecnologia e um sistema de logística de coleta e distribuição que se adapta às necessidades de cada cliente.

Como Operador de Caldeira você será responsável por:

  • Monitorar e controlar o funcionamento das caldeiras, ajustando os controles de acordo com os parâmetros de operação, como temperatura, pressão, fluxo de água e combustível;
  • Realizar verificações regulares nas caldeiras para garantir seu funcionamento adequado, incluindo limpeza de tubos, inspeção de válvulas e sistemas de segurança, e lubrificação de componentes;
  • Garantir o abastecimento de combustíveis e ajustar as taxas de alimentação conforme necessário para otimizar a eficiência energética e operacional das caldeiras;
  • Monitorar os parâmetros operacionais, como níveis de água, temperatura de vapor, pressão e emissões de gases, utilizando instrumentos de medição e sistemas de controle automatizados;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas de segurança, ambientais e regulatórias aplicáveis à operação de caldeiras, incluindo a manutenção de registros e relatórios conforme exigido;
  • Seguir rigorosamente procedimentos de segurança no trabalho, utilizar Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) adequados e adotar práticas seguras para prevenir acidentes e lesões durante a operação das caldeiras;
  • Participar de treinamentos contínuos para atualização de conhecimentos técnicos, novas tecnologias e melhores práticas na operação de caldeiras, garantindo competência e eficiência no trabalho.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Ensino Médio completo e curso na área;
  • Experiência comprovada como Operador de Caldeira.

The Security Manager will be responsible for implementing and overseeing security operationsfor the Mexicali, MX site, ensuring a safe and secure environment for employees, assets, and business operations. The role involves risk assessment, regulatory compliance, executive protection, investigations, emergency response, vendor management, and cross-functional collaboration. The Security Manager will report to the Global Security Director and work closely with site leadership, HR, Legal, EHS, and government agencies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, enforce, and continuously improve security strategies to protect employees, facilities, and company assets.

• Conduct risk assessments, identify threats, and implement mitigation measures to reduce security vulnerabilities across all three sites.

• Manage 24/7 security operations, ensuring effective deployment of security personnel and technology.

• Oversee and maintain CCTV, access control, perimeter security, and alarm systems to prevent unauthorized access or incidents.

• Supervise third-party security vendors, ensuring compliance with company policies, performance benchmarks, and contract requirements.

• Ensure the operational readiness and maintenance of all security infrastructure and recommend technology upgrades to enhance site security.

• Support liaison efforts with law enforcement, government agencies (PNP, NBI, Customs, AHJ), and regulatory bodies to assist with security initiatives and compliance requirements.

• Ensure compliance with C-TPAT and global supply chain security standards, conducting internal audits, customer security walkthroughs, and risk mitigation planning.

• Lead and coordinate security investigations related to theft, fraud, workplace violence, and operational breaches, collaborating with HR and Legal as necessary.

• Develop, implement, and test emergency response protocols for incidents such as fire, natural disasters, active shooter situations, and civil unrest.

• Conduct security drills and training programs to ensure crisis preparedness across all sites.

• Act as the point of contact for emergency coordination and escalation.

• Oversee executive protection programs for senior leaders and high-risk personnel as required, ensuring proper security planning and travel risk assessments.

• Support security awareness initiatives and training programs for employees and security personnel to strengthen internal security culture and vigilance.

• Provide on-call emergency response support and travel between sites as needed to coordinate security operations effectively.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Security Management, Criminology, Law Enforcement, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in corporate security, law enforcement, military, or a similar field.

• Strong expertise in risk management, security investigations, executive protection, and emergency response planning.

• Experience in C-TPAT compliance, security audits, and customer security support is highly preferred.

• Proven ability to liaise with law enforcement, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.

• Strong knowledge of security technology solutions, including CCTV, access control, and alarm systems.

• Ability to travel between Laguna, Cavite, and Eastwood sites and provide on-call emergency response support.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Office-based role with frequent on-site security inspections.

• Expected to be on-call 24/7 for emergencies, crisis response, and executive protection support.

• Regular coordination with senior management, local law enforcement, and government agencies.

title: Procurement and Logistics Associate
description:
Program Overview : Chemonics International, a US-based international development consulting firm, seeks a Procurement and Logistics Specialist for the USAID Iraq Together project. Iraq Together aims to provide more equitable, efficient, and sustainable public services in Iraq, as well as improving government responsiveness to citizens’ needs and demands. Objectives of this project include working with the Government of Iraq (GOI) to improve service delivery and strengthen democratic and participatory governance.

Position Overview: The Procurement and Logistics Associate will be responsible for leading the technical and operational procurement processes on Iraq Together, in coordination with the Operations Director and their team. The individual will ensure quality standards are met, and all procurements are cost-effective and compliant with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, and Iraqi government laws. This role will oversee the full procurement cycle, including support to the program teams as required, and lead the logistical operations of the project activities and office facilities. This position is open to Iraqi nationals residing in Baghdad, Iraq.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Preserve the integrity of the procurement process, including drafting project procurement documents including all solicitations, negotiation memos, consents to subcontract, and applicable waivers.
  • Maintain organized and concise procurement files that document project compliance with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, as well as local, third country, or US government rules that affect the procurement process.
  • Provide guidance to technical and operational staff on procurement/compliance policies, in particular those contained in FAR, CFR, ADS, and AIDAR regulating procurement.
  • Enforce clear and transparent procurement procedures.
  • Work directly with local, regional, or international vendors and service providers to obtain quotations and/or to conduct procurements of commodities or services.
  • Monitor contracts and purchase orders and conduct follow-up as necessary to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.
  • Compile all required documentation to facilitate payment requests.
  • Organize and participate in internal evaluation committees.
  • Monitor for any procurement-related conflict of interest and ensure the project’s procurement process is open and transparent.
  • Work with project leadership to answer any questions or provide USAID with any requested information about project procurements.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of procurement, subcontracts and grants required.
  • Experience working for USAID or other donor funded projects strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience and understanding of procurement procedures of international organizations.
  • Strong organizational, management, and administrative skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work efficiently and respectfully with a diverse group of people.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated leadership, versatility, and integrity.
  • Proficiency in written and oral Arabic and English is required; written and oral fluency in Kurdish, and other local languages is a plus, but not required.

Na saída da garagem, retirar a FCV e selo de vistoria no setor de tráfego; Conferir se o Check List está no interior do veículo; Realizar vistoria do veículo conforme Check List, anotar / conferir numeração do hodômetro no Check List, sessão aberta e acionamento de campainhas;

Passar com o veículo pela vistoria de saída e recolhida em conjunto com inspetor de frota; No recolhimento do veículo à garagem, após às 18h, acompanhar o abastecimento do veículo (sem sair do veículo), antes de estacionar na sua vaga estabelecida; Durante o processo de estacionamento, verificar se o freio estacionário está acionado;

Realizar o transporte de passageiros adequadamente, prezando pela direção defensiva, segurança dos passageiros, pedestres e demais pessoas envolvidas no trânsito, seguir corretamente itinerário definido; Atender as regras da empresa, da gerenciadora de transporte público e legislação de trânsito vigente; Acatar e atender as solicitações determinadas pela fiscalização/operação; Cumprir os horários determinados pela gerenciadora de transporte; Atender aos itens relacionados a regime de escalas conforme contrato de trabalho; Seguir horários de trabalhos conforme necessidade da empresa, atendendo a convenção coletiva de trabalho vigente; Em caso de acidente, se houver vítimas, prestar socorro ligando para as autoridades competentes de emergência, conforme números informados no verso do Check List; Preencher informações estabelecidas no Check List/Relatório de Ocorrência, conforme procedimento interno; O motorista que trabalhar em linha e horário sem a presença do cobrador deverá cobrar tarifas, de acordo com o valor estabelecido, oferecendo o troco pontualmente de forma correta; Preencher ficha com o número de passageiros (conforme catraca), de acordo com horários estabelecidos na FVC nos pontos de regulagem; Abrir sessão e fechar a mesma, coletando todas as informações do número de passageiros pagantes, isentos, estudantes; Transferir informações coletadas para o sistema SBE (Sistema de Bilhetagem Eletrônica); Gerar extrato e realizar o acerto de valores arrecadados diariamente; Realizar o acerto (de todas as suas jornadas), conforme estabelecido pelo procedimento, não podendo realizar o acerto duplo, nem no dia seguinte; Deverá ser colocado o dinheiro arrecadado no malote, juntamente com o extrato e depositar na boca de lobo; Verificar diariamente edital no setor de arrecadação, de pendências ou sobras de valores arrecadados; Atender aos convites para treinamento e palestras, ou apresentar justificativa legal, caso não haja comparecimento.
